name: Sky Climb
hook: Charge your jumps. Climb forever. Try not to fall.
how: Hold jump to charge and let go to leap: the longer you hold, the higher you fly. Climb an endless tower of platforms with everyone else. Miss a jump and you fall until something catches you.
controls: Arrow keys or A/D, hold and release Space, or on-screen ◀ ▶ and Jump
uses: The highest anyone has climbed, in meters.
Bot climbers race up around you until enough people join. The host's browser runs them; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone climbs the same tower, built from one seed, and sees every leap and fall.
ideas: Add coins on the platforms and a shop for hats
Make a wind that blows everyone sideways above 100 m
Add platforms that crumble a second after you land
